Welcome. This is a free course that teaches R one day at a time. You learn by writing code: every lesson has examples you can edit and graded exercises you can run **in this browser tab**. There is nothing to install for the first day.

**Who it is for:** complete beginners with no programming background, analysts moving from Excel, and students.

## How it works

1. **One lesson a day.** Each lesson takes 1.5 to 3 hours. Go slower if you need to: the 21 days are a guide, not a deadline.
2. **Run every example.** Click **Run Code** on any code block. Change the code and run it again. You cannot break anything.
3. **Do the exercises.** Each exercise checks your answer and tells you if it is right. Use **Show Hint** if you are stuck and **Show Solution** to compare your answer.
4. **Do the "Your turn" challenge.** It has no answer checker. It is where you practise thinking for yourself.

::: {.callout-note}
## The first time you run code
The first run on each page takes a few seconds while R loads in your browser. After that, code runs straight away.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Being honest about "expert"
By Day 21 you will be able to write tested, packaged and efficient R code. Real fluency comes from using R on your own problems after the course, and the capstone project is your first step.
:::
